Name: EoH Bunker Expansion AI Positions
Notes: These are bunker AI placement positions provided for the EoH bunker.
Active AI system direction: DayZ Expansion AI.
AI Bandits / AIB_Unleashed is deprecated for bunker defenders because testing showed unarmed and unkillable AI behavior.
Use these positions as the source of truth for Expansion AI bunker patrol/static spawn conversion.

notes: Use DayZ Expansion AI for bunker defenders.
Do not use AI Bandits / AIB_Unleashed for EoH bunker defenders.
Bunker AI must be armed, hostile, and killable.
Preferred EoH behavior: spawn or activate bunker defenders when the punchcard panel is opened, then pair it with the global bunker alert.
Fallback behavior: static Expansion AI bunker defenders placed at these coordinates if triggered spawning is not available yet.
Recommended loadout baseline: EoH_AI_HighValue_Hard or a dedicated EoH_Bunker_Elite loadout.
